::: {#lem-sum-deviations-zero}
#### Deviations from the mean sum to zero

For any data $z_1, \ldots, z_n$ with mean $\bar{z}$
(for example, the $\rvar_\iobs$ or the $\outvar_\iobs$), the deviations from the mean sum to zero:

$$\sumin (z_i - \bar{z}) = 0.$$
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-sum-deviations-zero.

:::
